name: Golden Bear Pass
description: California State Parks offers the Golden Bear Pass to ensure that cost is not a barrier to enjoying the state's natural treasures, providing free access to income-eligible residents and seniors.
fullDescription: California State Parks offers the Golden Bear Pass to ensure that cost is not a barrier to enjoying the state's natural treasures, providing free access to income-eligible residents and seniors.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free vehicle day-use entry at more than 200 California State Parks units that accept the pass
- Valid from the date issued through December 31 of that year
- For CalWORKs, SSI, and Tribal TANF recipients
- Also for adults 62+ with average gross monthly income up to $1,732 (single) or $2,352 (married, combined)
- A 30-day temporary pass is issued while your pass is mailed
howToGetIt: Apply online through ReserveCalifornia, in person at a State Parks pass sales location, or by mail with the application and proof of eligibility. CalWORKs families can apply online through the California Department of Social Services (cdss.ca.gov/goldenbearpass). Tribal TANF recipients apply through their Tribal TANF administrator. Online applications may take longer than usual to process.
keywords: Golden Bear Pass, state parks, free day use, CalWORKs, SSI, Tribal TANF, senior 62+, low-income
